title: Collect in Portal shows only when the customer portal allows it
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales - Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • The shop takes online payments and the user has Customer Portal access; be able to test both a portal that confirms it can collect and one that declines.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Create Deposit dialog and observe the button row (Record Deposit and Collect In Portal).
  2. When the portal confirms, click Collect In Portal and follow the handoff to pay.
  3. When the portal declines, read the Collect In Portal button state and hover it.
  4. After a portal-collected deposit, check it landed on this sale and shows in payment history.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • ShopView asks the Customer Portal whether it can collect for this sale before offering the handoff, and offers Collect in Portal only on a yes; the handoff hands the customer to the portal to pay (card reader or online, on whatever device is open).
  • When the portal declines, Collect in Portal stays visible but is disabled and shows the portal's own reason on hover.
  • A deposit collected through the portal lands on the correct part sale and shows in its payment history.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R8: “Collect in Portal hands the customer to the Customer Portal to pay, on a card reader or online, on whatever device is already open”
  • S8-R9: “ShopView asks the Customer Portal whether it can collect for this sale before offering the handoff, and offers it only on a yes”
  • S8-R10: “When the portal declines, Collect in Portal stays visible, is disabled, and shows the portal's own reason on hover”
  • S8-R11: “A deposit collected through the portal lands on the correct part sale and shows in its payment history”
